southern: Peru mine output: Toquepala + Cuajone + SX-EW for copper; two mines for molybdenum. Exclude Ilo smelting/refining. The bulk file identifies both SX-EW plants; parent reports combined SX-EW under Toquepala. Small copper gaps remain; molybdenum agrees within display precision.
hudbay: Use Peru contained-metal production, before smelter deductions, and annual columns. Constancia/Pampacancha share the Constancia plant. Do not use consolidated Canada/Peru values or payable metal sold. Tiny silver gaps and the 2019 three-metal gaps remain unexplained.
antamina: Teck gives 100% calendar-year output; no ownership scaling is applied. Ministry row is Antamina/Huincush. Copper and zinc differ in every year. Coverage of metals across different concentrate products and the original submitted assays remain unresolved; size alone does not resolve this.
nexa_peru: The detailed ministry files identify Cerro Lindo for this legal-company zinc row in all five years. Do not add Atacocha or El Porvenir. Both sources describe concentrated fine metal, but product-stream coverage and original submitted assays remain unresolved.
cerro_verde: English table explicitly reports recoverable pounds, whereas ministry reports fine metal at concentration/leaching stage. Do not treat the copper gap or rounded molybdenum agreement as proof of identical measurement.
yanacocha: Use consolidated 100% output, not changing attributable ownership. Gold numbers exist, but leached/poured/refined measurement and inventory cutoff are not explicitly bridged. Silver ministry values were recovered from bulk records; a matching Western annual silver series was not established.
gold_fields: Use technical-report Table 10.4.1 as a diagnostic plant-production series. It differs from the headline production series; historical columns have coarse precision. Commercial payability is discussed separately. Spanish 2023 company communications repeat the English headline numbers, weakening a language-specific explanation. Do not call the plant/headline/ministerial values identical concepts yet.
la_arena: Full-year 2020–23, 100% La Arena. English says mine gold/dore production; ministry fine grams from leaching. Need explicit product/assay/cutoff bridge before contradiction. 2019 English figures begin on February 22 and cannot be compared to a full calendar year.
shahuindo: Full-year 2020–23, 100% Shahuindo. English says mine gold/dore production; ministry fine grams from leaching. Need explicit product/assay/cutoff bridge. 2019 English figures begin February 22. The technical report confirms dore assay and refinery arrangements but supplies no reconciliation of the observed annual gaps.
ares: Sum Inmaculada and Pallancata, excluding San Jose in Argentina. 2019 subtotal omits Arcata and cannot support comparison. Ministry plant aliases and process labels change; fine silver versus company production and cutoffs remain unresolved even where gold numerically agrees.
buenaventura: Sum direct mines Orcopampa, Julcani, Tambomayo, not attributable consolidated group. Host bulk plant/process labels are not a complete year-consistent bridge (especially 2020); company output stage and treatment of other material remain unresolved.
